notes.title: 09/10/2025 Maintenance
notes.content:
[p]Dear Hero Community![/p][p]We will be performing maintenance at 22:00 PM (PDT) on Sep. 10th.
We expect this maintenance to last about 2~3 hours.
Kindly find detailed information below.[/p][p align="start"]Downtime: Sep. 10th, 22:00 PM (PDT) - Sep. 11th, 01:00 AM (PDT).[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][b]Details[/b][/p][p][b]0-1. \[Delete] Camel Pendant & Frozen Guild Coin(Even)
[/b]- Camel Pendant will be deleted for 1st half Camel Pendant Event.
- Post Aid item(Even) items will be deleted.
- The reward items(Frozen Guild Coin-Even) will be deleted.
- Frozen Guild War Reward(Even) items will be deleted.

[/p][p align="start"][b]1. On-going Event - 2025 Autumn Festival[/b]

- Period: August 28th ~ September 24th, 2025

1) Daily Check-in Event
2) Colorful Maple Leaf
3) Maple Branch, and Transform book
4) Camel Chase Rally Event
5) Camel Pendant Event
6) Special Trade
7) Death Valley Respawn Time Reduction Event

For more details, please visit the link below.
[url="https://hero.netgame.com/news/view.mgame?idx=4204"][u]08/27/2025 Maintenance[/u][/url] 

[b]
2. Return of the Omok [/b]
[b]
Now the Omok item has been added to every Tavern Clerk NPC.

[/b]Omok has returned at your request!
Previously, Omok was removed due to an issue that occurred depending on individual environments, but thanks to your requests, it is now back.
Please note that if errors occur when running Omok due to network or other environmental differences, no further fixes can be made.
We hope many of you will be able to enjoy Omok again without any issues!
[b]

3. Camel Pendant Event (1st half)

- 1st half : August 28th ~ September 10th, 2025[/b]
- 2nd half : September 11st ~ September 24th, 2025[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/d597078938db31f76f9be55cd85ba2952807d902.png"][/img][/p][p][b]\[1st Camel Pendant Event][/b][/p][p]※ Please make sure to place the camel pendant in your inventory.[/p][p][/p][p]Period: August 28th ~ September 10th, 2025[/p][p][b]1st place Winner (1 player):[/b][/p][p]Autumn Pet Box[/p][p]Blessing of the Water Spirit[/p][p]Advanced Holy Water Coupon[/p][p][/p][p][b]2nd place Winner (1 player):[/b][/p][p]Autumn Pet Box[/p][p]Blessing of the Fire Spirit[/p][p]Advanced Holy Water Coupon[/p][p][/p][p][b]3rd place Winner (1 player):[/b][/p][p]Transform Pill(S)[/p][p]Advanced Holy Water Coupon[/p][p]Soul Stone 5Kyu Charm of Luck[/p][p]Soul Stone 4Kyu Charm of Luck[/p][p][/p][p][b]Over 60 Camel Pendant (All players):[/b][/p][p]Miracle Shenronian Pouch(E)[/p][p]Four Gracious herbal medicine(E) x10[/p][p][/p][p][b]Over 30 Camel Pendant (All players):[/b][/p][p]Miracle Shenronian Pouch(E)[/p][p]Four Gracious herbal medicine(E) x5※ Note ) 1~3 place reward items can be traded/put in consignment.[/p][p]※ Note ) Reward items (except 1~3 place) will be deleted after 10/22/2025 maintenance.[/p][p]※ Note ) When you open the Autumn Pet Box, you will obtain either a \[Striped raccoon] or \[Daram].[/p][p]※ Note ) When you right click Four Gracious herbal medicine(E), you will recover relax point.[/p][p]※ Note ) Event winner list will be uploaded within 2~3 days.[/p][p]※ Note ) Event Reward will be provided within 3~4 days.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]4. New Update on HT Tavern[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[END][/b][/p][p]Five Element Marble Box[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[New Limited Sale] [/b][/p][p]-Period: September 11th ~ September 24th, 2025 (2 weeks)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/d223b4501cad08967388d09c1d5b367b331e1ebe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]5. Update & Fixed
[/b]
[b]\[Update]
[/b]The drop rate of Beast/Empress weapons in Frozen Mountain has been slightly increased.
[b]
\[Fixed]
[/b]It has been confirmed that only part of the Camel Chase Rally event map was accessible.
This has now been fixed so that both players and monsters can move across the entire event map.


[b]6. Upcoming Update

[/b]- The Growth Support Event is scheduled to open on the September 24 maintenance.
- The Dark Night Map update is planned to be released during the last maintenance of October.
[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support.
We hope you enjoy the autumn with Hero Plus!

Regards,
Team Hero[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 08/13/2025 Maintenance
notes.content:
[p]Dear Hero Community!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/99b7c58272ac88eeacf3041a33acc5938cccae7e.png"][/img]
We will be performing maintenance at 22:00 PM (PDT) on August. 13th.
We expect this maintenance to last about 3~4 hours.
Kindly find detailed information below.[/p][p align="start"]Downtime: August. 13th, 22:00 PM (PDT) - August. 14th, 00:30 AM (PDT).[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][b]Details[/b]
We would like to inform you of the scheduled maintenance and upcoming updates. Please see below for full details:

[b]1. \[Delete] Event item

[/b]- Post Aid item(Odd) items will be deleted.
- Frozen Guild War Reward(Odd) items will be deleted.
- Family Month Premium User Event items will be deleted.
[b]

2. Craft System Update

[/b]Now you can use the crafting system more simply and conveniently!
The Craft Book item will be updated so that you can craft immediately by right-clicking on it.

\[Detail]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/3e4fe88b873442a706dc047d8401bf5d1c7e7f98.png"][/img][b]

3. Ongoing Event
[/b]
[b]Hero 10th Anniversary Event
[/b]- [url="https://hero.netgame.com/news/view.mgame?idx=4171"][u][b]07/30/2025 Maintenance (10th Anniversary)[/b][/u][/url] [/p][p align="start"]- [url="https://hero.netgame.com/news/view.mgame?idx=4168"][u][b]\[Facebook Follow Event Guide][/b][/u][/url] [/p][p align="start"]- [url="https://hero.netgame.com/news/view.mgame?idx=4169"][u][b]New Update on HT Tavern + Bonus Event (10th Anniversary)[/b][/u][/url] 
[/p][p align="start"][b]※ Important Note for the Celestial Orb Event Items[u]
[/u][/b]! The Celestial Orb Event Reward items are tradable and can be stored in your storage.
! 2025 Socket Coupon: It will be deleted during the last maintenance of December 2026.

For more details on the Celestial Orb Event reward items
>> [url="https://hero.netgame.com/news/view.mgame?idx=4182"]\[Notice] Celestial Orb Reward & Usage Reminder[/url] [b]

4. Screenshot EXP Event (8/14/2025)

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/cf2c27c10dab60ad4beeb21060b2ed4dab4767f7.png"][/img]
When?
Right after the 8/13/2025 maintenance.
>> August. 14th 00:30 (PDT) <<

Where?
NPC 10th Anniversary Cake, Dragon Castle.

Mission?
Shout "Hero Plus" and obtain additional EXP/Item Drop/Gold hours!

For more details for the event...>> [url="https://hero.netgame.com/news/view.mgame?idx=4188"][b]Screenshot EXP Event (Hero 10th Anniversary)[/b][/url] [u][b]

[/b][/u][b]5. Removal of items from Paid Lot Box[/b]
The Item \[Seal Tool]/\[Unseal Tool], which was previously obtainable
from paid Lot Boxes, will no longer be available.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/7a5637940ba742f0aad0a3591659d41b5a3ff207.png"][/img]
This item shares the same function as the Seal item already
in your inventory, making it redundant and unnecessary.

Players can continue to use the existing Seal without any loss of functionality.


[b]6. Lot Box Reward Renewal Announcement[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/83dba10bfef8d6fd6c43b12f022509db7576e7c8.png"][/img]We are preparing a full-scale update of the Lot Box Reward, scheduled to go live
on August 27, 2025 during the regular maintenance.

Look forward to a revamped reward structure and improved user experience.
[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][b]7. Great Dragon Temple Improved[/b][/p][p]The monster spawn location in the Great Dragon Temple (PVP, Non-PVP) map have been changed.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on feedback from players regarding monsters being concentrated in certain areas and[/p][p]causing inconvenience while hunting, the spawn locations have been adjusted to provide a better hunting environment.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31095607/b23f023c28b11327ce0af794a6a86de3b765c225.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]
Thank you for your continued support.
We hope you enjoy the summer with Hero Plus!

Team Hero[/p]

tags.feature: └ A new Appearance Change Shop has been added in the Dragon Castle / Xian, Sina NPC.
└ Appearance items can be dismantled.

└ Appearances can be applied regardless of character class
   (Non-Divine, Divine, Darkness).
An Illusion holy water is required to perform an appearance change.
It can be purchased from Hero Tavern or obtained through events.

└ Items that have been appearance-changed will become
   [[b]Cannot trade or store[/b]] starting from July 31.

└ Appearance-changed armor will return to [[b]Can trade or store[/b]]
   status once the appearance is reset.

└ Players who wish to reset the appearance can submit a ticket,
   and we will restore them with   [[u]original equipment + appearance item + 1 Illusion Holy Water[/u]].

└ Tickets can be submitted even before October 22,
   and the restoration process will be handled sequentially.

└ Please note that this restoration support will be available for
   approximately three months starting July 31,
   ending on October 22, 2025.
└ A total of three reminder notices will be posted regarding this issue.
└ The inquiry format for appearance reset restoration is provided below.

● For abuse prevention purposes, please note that after receiving
   a restoration once, any subsequent appearance changes are
   not eligible for additional restoration.

● Items that had already undergone an appearance change prior
   to the restoration point are eligible for additional restoration.

● The "Illusion Holy Water" item returned during the restoration process
   will be provided as a non-tradeable item.
● The "Illusion Holy Water" item will be deleted on the first maintenance day of August 2026.

Illusion Holy Water granted during the restoration will be deleted
   on the first maintenance day of August 2026.
You can purchase a total of four types of items from Sina’s Shop.
- Mask Shop(Appearance)
- Helm Shop(Appearance)
- Clothing Shop(Appearance)
- Boots Shop(Appearance)
To complete a purchase, you will need an Appearance Voucher.
The voucher can be purchased from Tavern or obtained through events.

Appearance items can be obtained by exchanging an
   [Appearance Change Voucher] with NPC Sina, located in the Xian.
└ While only base equipment appearances are shown, you can preview the look by holding Shift and left-clicking on the item.

When dismantling appearance items, you can obtain
   a certain amount of [Appearance Change Vouchers]
   through the Blacksmith Jang.
An event offering various appearance rewards will be held alongside the appearance change update.

notes.title: 06/04/2025 Maintenance
notes.content:
Dear Hero Community!

We will be performing maintenance at 22:00 PM (PDT) on June. 04th.
We expect this maintenance to last about 3~4 hours.
Kindly find detailed information below.

Downtime: June. 04th, 22:00 PM (PDT) - June. 05th, 01:00 AM (PDT).

Details
We would like to inform you of the scheduled maintenance and upcoming updates. Please see below for full details:

1. [Delete] Event item
- Frozen Guild War Reward(Odd) items will be deleted.
- Post Aid item(Odd) items will be deleted.


2. Premium Buff Reward Issue Resolved (05/28/2025)
We would like to inform you that the item stacking issue has now been resolved.
As a result, players are now able to receive two separate [Re-D Scroll(R/L)(Prem)] items (1 each, total of 2).

Visit NPC Event Manager Mae and select the menu corresponding to your active premium buff(Water/Fire) to claim your reward properly.


3. Family Month Event - Now in Progress!
The Family Month Event is currently underway from May 22 to June 18, 2025.
Celebrate with us and don’t miss out on the seasonal quests, drops, and special rewards!


4. Upcoming Updates & Events
Here’s what’s coming next after the Family Month celebration ends:

- Enhancement Event (2 Weeks, 06/19/2025-07/02/2025)
A full-featured enhancement-focused event will run for two weeks, giving you better chances to strengthen your equipment!

- Boss Respawn Reduction – Death Valley Map (2 Weeks, 06/19/2025-07/02/2025)
Boss monsters in the Death Valley area will respawn 50% faster for a limited time.

- Improved Drop Rates – Death Valley Map
Drop rates for certain armor and accessory items in the Death Valley will be improved to provide a more rewarding hunting experience.

- Virago Accessory Crafting Rate Improved
The crafting success rate for Virago Accessories will be adjusted upward, making them easier to obtain.


5. Hero Tavern
[END] ( -June 04, 2025)
Water Guild Robe(Normal)

[NEW] June 04, 2025
- Period: June 04, 2025 ~ August 28, 2025 (3 months, 12 weeks)
Dark Guild Robe(Normal) 



We want to assure you that the Team Hero is fully committed to improving the Death Valley Map experience, and we are actively listening to your feedback.

Our goal is to ensure you enjoy a smoother, more balanced gameplay environment.

Thank you for your continued support!
Team Hero

notes.title: Warning to Harassment (2024)
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,

We are receiving large amount of tickets regarding
Racism and sexist insults, harassment issue.

We have decided to strictly manage the hero community
by increase in punishment of players when they uses
sexist insults and racism insults.

Which means that if players harass players with
[b]Sexual remarks, racism, harassing behavior[/b] including
[b]comments that are sexual, racist, religious or related to
gender or creed[/b]. In addition, [b]national defamation, slander,[/b]
or [b]criticizing[/b] opponent player is absolutely not allowed.

[b]We will strictly and personally ban players without mercy.[/b]

In order for us to investigate the situation, players will
need to provide me necessary information and evidence.

Netgame highly suggest for players to ignore the conflict but

1. Do not send us just 1 screenshot.
2. We will need FULL conversation with many screenshots
3. IF we believe that the harassment was too overboard,
we will punish players by banning their account.

Netgame can promise you that we wish for Hero community
to be respectful and fair for every players.

Any type of act or behavior deemd inappropriated by Hero Plus
will be dealt with fairness and accordingly.

Best Regards,
Team Hero

notes.title: [Re-patch] Steam Old Client Error Issue
notes.content:
Dear Heroes Community,

We have identified an issue with the 'old client error' occurring on Steam accounts that have been inactive for an extended period.

Typically, if a Steam account has not received game updates for about six months, an 'old client error' message appears, and in such cases, we recommend reinstalling the game.

However, we have identified error issues with the reinstall client and are working to address this.

The Steam client's re-installation files will be updated on the upcoming maintenance date, September 14th.

[b][Steam Client Patch Maintenance][/b]
[b]September 14th, 2023.[/b]


We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Regards,
Hero Team

This will be done by bringing back old HT Set and allowing you to decorate your current sets with Illusion water. Not only this we have added a new boss monster to kill to receive rewards. To finally top off the hat we are adding new items to the HT box & a new map to really grind in the horrors within you! Please check the listed information below for details.

 
1)     Check in Event – Nothing drastically different but log in and check in to receive your rewards.

2)    New Map – A new map introducing “Dark Map”. A map that allows you to grind harder. However, there is new specific rules here. You will receive extra EXP than normal maps. But the monsters are stronger. We are providing payed Buffs to help you within this!
There is a big secret to the stats happening in “Dark Night”. Detail information will be provided soon. Not only this the drops will be a lot special differing from the other maps.
Grinding this map will allow you to gain access to new items / gold.

3)    Bounty Buff – We’ve been receiving a lot of interest in Bounty. We have brought it back to Hero Plus. Enjoy the paid purge system that is happening. Also, this update to protect from the mass murders we are adding a buff protection system also. We will put a bounty protection (PKing Proof) buff to hinder other from killing you. Let’s try to keep this Halloween frightful but safe and fun from all the kills and murder that may happen! 😊

4)    New Update on HT and Items – We have received a lot of interest in new HT Items that will help you decorate your items. We are introducing older HT sets to help you decorate your current armor’s with Holy Illusion Water. Therefore, try to enjoy a diversity of looks.

5)    Boss Monster / The Tree of Horror – A random boss monster will appear on CI for at a designated time to receive a box reward that can be claimed. Gather in groups of numbers
and receive the rewards from claiming the kills of the monster.
 

Hero Team has tried their best to allow a better and a diverse experience to help out the community and bring new contents in.

Really do hope you guys are pumped up about this and surely hope you will enjoy it.

Thanks

-Hero Team

We will be performing a new update for the upcoming 5th anniversary for Hero Plus. You are all invited to this celebration and are all welcome. We have arranged new things for this Anniversary to give back to the loyal supporters of our Hero Plus game. To celebrate the Hero Plus on Steam, Netgame will hold 
exciting events to bring our both Steam users and Netgame 
users can enjoy :)

  A. Free Steam Starter Kits

  Players who have create Steam account will be able
  to receive "Steam Starter Kits" after login.
  The Steam Starter Kits is the best way to begin your 
  journey in Hero Plus with valuable and epic items 
  to customize your gameplay.

  B. Steam Welcome Coin Event

 - Mission : Every players will get Steam Coin every 
                   2 hours of game play.
 - Reward : Exchange Steam Coin to valuable items
                  from Event Manager Mae.

  * Players will not be able to receive Coin if they are
    not connected to the game.

   
Regards
Shadow
